content:
Thunderbird is what is called an e-mail client application. It connects to e-mail accounts that are hosted elsewhere (Google, Microsoft, Apple, internet service providers, et al.) It is not possible to create a brand new e-mail account/address in Thunderbird. The account/address must exist somewhere else already. Thunderbird is free.

Thunderbird Pro, a paid service under development, will offer Thunderbird e-mail addresses and use a new e-mail service ("Thundermail" or "Thunderbird Pro", I'm not sure. The name may have been changed recently.). As you saw, if you are interested in getting a brand new Thunderbird e-mail address, you must put your name on the waiting list.

So, no, you cannot get a new e-mail account/address associated with Thunderbird now. Maybe soon. And it will be part of a paid service.

You can, however, get a new e-mail account/address from Google, Microsoft, Apple, Fastmail (my recommendation, paid) and other services, set up that account in Thunderbird, and use Thunderbird to receive, send, and store messages.

Più in generale Per poter inquadrare il problema prova a fornire queste informazioni:

  1. Versione di Thunderbird
  2. Versione del sistema operativo
  3. Provider delle caselle email (Gmail, Libero, Hotmail, etc.)
  4. Tipologia di account (POP3, IMAP)
  5. Estensioni installate
  6. Messaggi di errore che vengono visualizzati durante l'utilizzo di Thunderbird
  7. Software di sicurezza eventualmente presenti (Antivirus e simili)
  8. Screenshot del problema
